rows.text: Edomotics began in 2011 with people who wanted integrated automation in their own homes and couldn’t find a credible way to get it in India. So they built the practice instead. Today it is a team of more than sixty, based in Hyderabad and Bengaluru, with projects across Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam.

rows.text: Edomotics was started by people who wanted integrated automation in their own homes and could not find high-quality, credible brands in the Indian market. So they built the practice instead.
The aim has stayed the same since 2011: to be innovative, passionate and nimble, to delight the people we work for, and to deliver a better way of living at home.

Today Edomotics designs integrated automation and audio-video systems for residential and commercial spaces, with a team of more than sixty based in Hyderabad and Bengaluru, and projects across Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam.
